title: Latte art at dawn
idea: a barista pours latte art at dawn in an empty cafe
style: Kodak 250D look, warm highlights, muted shadows, fine grain
subject: a barista in a grey apron, sleeves rolled, steady hands holding a steel milk jug
setting: an empty cafe at dawn, a wooden counter lit by low sun through the front window
lens: 100mm macro, f/4, shallow depth of field
light: low golden sun as key from camera-right, soft bounce fill, steam backlit

beats.action: the milk jug tilts and a thin white stream hits the brown crema
the stream wobbles side to side and a white heart forms on the surface
the jug lifts and draws a thin line through the heart
the barista sets the jug down; steam rises off the cup

physics: milk pours in a steady column and ripples on contact; steam rises and curls; the jug has weight and lands with a small tap

sound.fx: milk pouring, a ceramic tap as the jug lands

notes: Good first test for any model: one subject, one light, one liquid.
